title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
key_facts: Paris-based Mistral AI launched Mistral Large 4 on Tuesday (6 Oct 2026), a model with 1 trillion parameters, of which about 49 billion are active per answer.
The nickname "Le Chonk" comes from a fan-made joke model, "Le Chaton Fat", invented in June after Mistral renamed its Le Chat assistant to Vibe.
CEO Arthur Mensch played along and Mistral's launch post lists the model "very officially" as le Chonk.
Price is $1.36 per million input tokens and $4.18 per million output tokens, about a third of Claude Opus 5.5 on input and a fifth on output.
Mistral's chief scientist called it the strongest open-weight model from the US or Europe; that is the company's claim.
Large 4 scored 59.9 on AutomationBench, below Claude Sonnet 5.5 (71.8) and Opus 5.5 (69.5), and ranked second of five in a Surge AI blind coding test.
Mistral says it will release the model weights by the end of October.
quote_evidence: "[Mistral Large 4] is at the frontier of open models, and by far the strongest open-weight model from the US or Europe," Mistral AI's Chief scientist Guillaume Lample, wrote on X.
CEO Arthur Mensch played along, replying that the model was really called "le gros chaton," French for "the big kitten."
Mistral says it will release Large 4's weights—the trained numbers that make the model work—by the end of October
why_it_matters_hint: A major open-weight model priced well below US rivals, with performance claims others can test once the weights are released.
notes: Mostly company claims; independent testing awaits the weight release. Substantive MOD story; kept in FUN for the nickname angle, main session may move it.
